hypothesis: The independently useful daily dynamic Plackett-Luce state can improve the v312-style full-history exact-top3 ranker when supplied as fixed runner features during base-model training, without learning from v312 probabilities or using a small OOF residual head.

feature_definition.combination: append the six fixed v337 runner-state features to the v312 numeric runner feature matrix before the existing runner projection
feature_definition.normalization: training-fold statistics only; course-missing state rows remain explicit zero values with course_available=0
feature_definition.state_generation: v337 emits every date before updating any result from that date

base_model.source: v312 frozen runner/race inputs, pairwise tau20, current-meet 7 days/overall50/meet10, racer identity embedding, exact-top3 architecture and loss
base_model.training_folds: D6-D8 each train only on all strictly earlier races and predict its own validation fold
base_model.architecture: v312 unchanged except six appended numeric state features

evaluation.protocol: to be preregistered before full evaluation after smoke validation
evaluation.screen: matched-parent futility only; no screen result promotes or rejects unless the fixed futility condition is met
evaluation.full: D6-D8 direct saved-OOF comparison against v312 with race-index equality, date-cluster CI95, daily paired Wilcoxon and a newly declared Holm family
